craft_notes: Sthāyin: asymmetric-seat (yogāsana named). Rows: row 2 (context→mind may be). Close: may be (optative — posture as invitation). Rejected: 'haṭha pose name' — killed: seat kept plain; 'one-sitting-buttock' comic — killed: one-buttock kept dignified (it's real: sphija-eka).

lines: Soft seat, one buttock, hands feet unsupported:
by that context — supreme full mind may be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mṛdvāsane sphijaikena hastapādau nirāśrayam | nidhāya tatprasaṅgena parā pūrṇā matir bhavet

reads_against.argmap: How should one sit? → The asymmetric unsupported seat makes mind supreme and full.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness at the edge of intensity)
